dialogues.text: Is there anything you'd like to do?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: <color=#FFCC33FF>Is there anything you'd like to do?</color>

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: As a matter of fact... there is something I've been planning for a while now.

dialogues.speaker: Ningguang
dialogues.text: The next time we have an important policy decision on our hands, I'd like you to get involved.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Not exactly... I was thinking that you would be involved in the decision itself.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Rest assured, I am not prone to misjudgment.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The fount of knowledge and boldness of spirit that your travels have bequeathed upon you are sure to imbue your policies with rare and valuable foresight.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: After the decision is made, if you could please shred any documentation that accumulates on the wall during the process.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: Liyue is due another paper snowstorm. This time, you will be the one to change the prevailing weather.

choices.text: I will rise to the challenge.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: I like your boldness of spirit.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: The world of commerce is a battleground, and policy-making requires conviction and decisiveness.

response.speaker: Ningguang
response.text: All that you have experienced during your travels is sure to imbue your policies with rare and valuable foresight.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I will give it my all.

choices.text: To study the thinking behind policy-making?
